data.title: Software Engineering Intern
data.description: 3-month paid software engineering internship working on backend microservices. You will contribute to production systems, write tests, and participate in code review. Open to penultimate and final year CS students.

data.title: Data Science Intern
data.description: 6-month data science internship in Munich. Responsibilities include building ML pipelines, data cleaning, and dashboard creation. Requires enrollment in a Bachelor or Master degree program in Data Science, Statistics, or Computer Science.

data.title: Frontend Developer Intern
data.description: Remote-friendly 4-month frontend internship building user-facing components in React and TypeScript. Suitable for students with basic React knowledge and a portfolio of personal projects.

data.title: Senior Cloud Architect
data.description: Senior Cloud Architect with 7+ years of experience required. This is a full-time permanent position, not an internship. Candidates must have professional certifications (AWS Solutions Architect Pro or equivalent).
